_README: Maps each SOP step to a selector on the LIVE REI BlackBook account for
Twin Home Buyer (logged in as Jonathan/Juan).
CONFIRMED  - matches a label visible in the account screenshots.
VERIFY     - best guess; confirm against the live DOM before first run.
NEEDS-DOM  - an icon/menu with no visible text; needs the real title/
aria-label or href, captured live. Left as a safe guess.
SAFETY: if any selector fails to match at runtime, the row is marked
Needs Review / Error and NO text is sent. Nothing is ever guessed at send.

login._status: URL confirmed: https://my.reiblackbook.com/services/account/login. Field selectors are tolerant guesses; login success is detected by navigating away from the login page (see adapter).
login.submitButton: button[type='submit'], button:has-text('Log In'), button:has-text('Login'), button:has-text('Sign In'), input[type='submit']

nav._status: VERIFY - top menu is Contacts / Tasks / Deals / Properties / ListHQ / More. Property Pipeline lives under the Properties menu.

propertyPipeline._status: CONFIRMED - Filter By: Feed Source, Status, Deal Type + Search box
propertyPipeline.searchInput: input[placeholder*='Search' i], input[type='search'], input[aria-label*='search' i], input[name*='search' i], .search input
propertyPipeline.resultRowLink: table tbody tr td a, .list-row a, [role='row'] a
propertyPipeline.noResultsMarker: text=/no result/i, text=/did not match/i, text=/no records/i, text=/no properties/i

smartContacts._status: VERIFY - Contacts area holds 7,845 contacts; many are 'Unknown' (no name), so name search is unreliable — address search in the Pipeline is primary.
smartContacts.searchInput: input[placeholder*='Search' i], input[type='search'], input[aria-label*='search' i], input[name*='search' i], .search input
smartContacts.resultRowLink: table tbody tr td a, .list-row a, [role='row'] a
smartContacts.noResultsMarker: text=/no result/i, text=/did not match/i, text=/no records/i

propertyRecord._status: NEEDS-DOM - after opening a Pipeline property, the automation opens its associated contact to text (confirmed workflow: Pipeline -> property -> contact). Capture the property detail page to confirm the link to its contact.
propertyRecord.associatedContactLink: text=Associated Contacts >> xpath=following::a[1], .associated-contacts a:first-child, a:has-text('View Contact')

contactRecord._status: CONFIRMED tabs: About / Chat / Activities / Notes / Tasks / Files; Tag(s) section holds chips

tags._status: RULE: read ALL tag chips in the Tag(s) section; the lead is textable UNLESS one of the chips matches 'badTags' below (case-insensitive, substring match). If the Tag(s) section can't be read at all, the row is held for review (never texted) because bad tags can't be ruled out.
tags._badTags_note: These mirror the real block rules in server/automation/constants.js (SAFETY_TAG_RULES), matched case-insensitively as substrings. 'Do Not Mail' is intentionally NOT here (per SOP it does not block a text — it only suppresses mail). Edit constants.js to change actual behavior; this list is the human-readable reference.

propertyStatus._status: VERIFY - property Sold/Listed status source not yet captured (may live on the property record or an MLS/status field).

history._status: PARTIAL - Chat tab confirmed (shows message + call thread). Activities/Notes tab containers still need a capture. Chat thread container is a best guess pending the Activities screenshot.

tagsWrite._status: CONFIRMED modal 'Add/Remove Tags': open via the '+' in the Tag(s) section; the 'Apply Tag(s)' dropdown (shows 'Select An Option'); confirm with the orange 'Add/Remove Tags' button. NOTE: the tag must be selectable in that dropdown - pre-create the 10 Revival tags once in REI so they appear, or the dropdown must allow creating on type.

chat._status: CONFIRMED: open via the 'Chat' tab; message box placeholder 'Write Your Reply...'; the orange send button's tooltip is 'Send Text'. Send is also verified by the message appearing in the thread, so it fails safe if the button can't be clicked.
chat.messageInput: textarea[placeholder*='Write Your Reply' i], textarea[placeholder*='reply' i]
chat.sendButton: [aria-label='Send Text' i], [title='Send Text' i], button:has-text('Send Text'), [aria-label*='send' i], button[title*='send' i]
